name: Alert when hotel report fails
description: Emails the owner when the weekly hotel report stops, saying what broke and whether any emails already went out. Without it a failed Monday run would go unnoticed, because the report runs unattended.

nodes.name: Email Failure Alert

parameters.subject: =[ALERT] Stopped: {{ $json.workflow.name }}

nodes.notes: Plain text on purpose: error messages can contain sheet values. Uses the same Gmail account as the report, so if Gmail itself is down this alert fails too.
